questions: How many antidot devices did you fabricate and measure, and in how many did you resolve fractional oscillations? Your p. 4 introduces AD #2 as a device "that showed a richer set of fractional quantum Hall states"; were there others beyond AD #1 and AD #2?

Why were the other devices, cooldowns or fractional states set aside? For example, at which fractions did you look for oscillations without resolving them (p. 6 mentions the 2/5 derivative states and 11/3)?
Which field, gate and displacement-field ranges did you measure beyond the windows shown in Fig. 3 and Figs. S13 to S18, and how did you pick each window inside a plateau?
What does the second-best dataset look like at ν = 7/3, where Fig. S17 shows a single map, and which other maps at ν = 8/3 show the small-period oscillation?

N comes from the field-period ratio to ν = 2 under a constant area (Fig. 4b), and the diameters in Fig. 4c use those same N values. Could you show the unrounded ratios with errors, an area estimate that does not use N (for example integer and fractional periods taken in the same gate-voltage range), and, for the edge-counting reading at ν = 4/3, the side-gate separation next to the diameter N = 2 would imply, with the same argument for 5/3, 7/3 and 8/3?

At ν = 4/3 the bias data suggest "an Aharonov–Bohm–like mechanism" (p. 23). Do the 2D-FFTs at 4/3 show any stripe family with the opposite slope, and do you have a temperature series at any fractional filling?

Do the small-period stripes at ν = 8/3 (Fig. S18a) and the jumps visible in Figs. S11c and S17a repeat when you resweep the same window, do the small-period stripes appear in the bottom-gate sweeps of Fig. S9, and did you check gate leakage?

Could you confirm which device the fractional bottom-gate data in Fig. S9g-l come from (the p. 20 text says AD #1, the caption says AD #2), and which device the "many well-developed fractional Hall states at B = 8 T" on p. 3 refers to, given the p. 11 note on "the absence of fractional quantum Hall states at a field of B = 8 T"?
